career_overview.short_description: Administer, secure, and maintain enterprise Linux servers, operating system storage, user access, services, and network connectivity.
responsibilities: Install, configure, and maintain Linux operating systems and enterprise distributions
Manage user accounts, group permissions, PAM authentication, and SSH access controls
Partition disks, configure Logical Volume Management (LVM), and manage filesystems
Control background services and daemons using systemd and automate tasks with cron and Bash
Configure host firewalls, monitor system logs with journalctl, and execute disaster recovery backups
representative_work: A hardened, production-ready enterprise Linux server deployment featuring LVM partitioned storage, non-root sudo accounts, hardened SSH key authentication, automated systemd service management, firewall rules, and automated rsync backup scripts.
core_skills: Linux filesystem hierarchy and terminal navigation
Storage partitioning and Logical Volume Management (LVM)
Package management with APT and DNF/YUM
Process control and systemd service units
Bash scripting and scheduled cron automation
System log auditing and rsync backup automation

roadmap.title: System Administrator: beginner foundations and starter project
roadmap.intended_learner: Motivated beginner; basic computer literacy assumed, with no prior professional experience.
roadmap.starting_requirements: Computer, internet access, text editor, terminal and modern browser. Most tasks use free software or local runtimes.
roadmap.final_outcome: A hardened, production-ready enterprise Linux server deployment featuring LVM partitioned storage, non-root sudo accounts, hardened SSH key authentication, automated systemd service management, firewall rules, and automated rsync backup scripts.
